default.summary: llm-d-router's built-in config, used when a run names none: queue depth, KV cache and prefix scorers, then the highest score.
default.yaml:
apiVersion: llm-d.ai/v1
kind: EndpointPickerConfig
plugins:
- type: queue-scorer
- type: kv-cache-utilization-scorer
- type: prefix-cache-scorer
- type: metrics-data-source
- type: core-metrics-extractor
schedulingProfiles:
- name: default
  plugins:
  - pluginRef: queue-scorer
    weight: 2
  - pluginRef: kv-cache-utilization-scorer
    weight: 2
  - pluginRef: prefix-cache-scorer
    weight: 3

load-aware.summary: Sends each request to the least-loaded instance.
load-aware.yaml:
apiVersion: llm-d.ai/v1
kind: EndpointPickerConfig
plugins:
- type: load-aware-scorer
- type: max-score-picker
- type: single-profile-handler
schedulingProfiles:
- name: default
  plugins:
  - pluginRef: load-aware-scorer
  - pluginRef: max-score-picker

prefix-affinity.summary: Keeps requests that share a prefix on the instance that served it first.
prefix-affinity.yaml:
apiVersion: llm-d.ai/v1
kind: EndpointPickerConfig
plugins:
- type: approx-prefix-cache-producer
- type: prefix-cache-scorer
- type: max-score-picker
- type: single-profile-handler
schedulingProfiles:
- name: default
  plugins:
  - pluginRef: prefix-cache-scorer
  - pluginRef: max-score-picker

queue.summary: Sends each request to the instance with the shortest queue.
queue.yaml:
apiVersion: llm-d.ai/v1
kind: EndpointPickerConfig
plugins:
- type: queue-scorer
- type: max-score-picker
- type: single-profile-handler
schedulingProfiles:
- name: default
  plugins:
  - pluginRef: queue-scorer
  - pluginRef: max-score-picker

queue-kv.summary: Weighs queue depth and free KV cache equally.
queue-kv.yaml:
apiVersion: llm-d.ai/v1
kind: EndpointPickerConfig
plugins:
- type: queue-scorer
- type: kv-cache-utilization-scorer
- type: max-score-picker
- type: single-profile-handler
schedulingProfiles:
- name: default
  plugins:
  - pluginRef: queue-scorer
    weight: 2.0
  - pluginRef: kv-cache-utilization-scorer
    weight: 2.0
  - pluginRef: max-score-picker

random.summary: Spreads requests at random; the baseline every scorer has to beat.
random.yaml:
apiVersion: llm-d.ai/v1
kind: EndpointPickerConfig
plugins:
- type: random-picker
- type: single-profile-handler
schedulingProfiles:
- name: default
  plugins:
  - pluginRef: random-picker

setup.script:
# the stack that priced this report (needs git and Go)
git clone --branch v0.15.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/inference-sim/inference-sim.git inference-sim
test "$(git -C inference-sim rev-parse HEAD)" = 762f1605ff27cd825d6b2cb2d9e991cd4b864c91 || echo "inference-sim: v0.15.0 moved off 762f1605" >&2
(cd inference-sim && go build -o blis main.go)
export PATH="$PWD/inference-sim:$PATH"

git clone --branch 0.5.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/inference-sim/blis-catalog.git blis-catalog
test "$(git -C blis-catalog rev-parse HEAD)" = b5550f750cb51571498577fbdc1c68f78cda67db || echo "blis-catalog: 0.5.0 moved off b5550f75" >&2
export BLIS_CATALOG="$PWD/blis-catalog"

git clone --branch v0.3.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/inference-sim/blis-registry.git blis-registry
test "$(git -C blis-registry rev-parse HEAD)" = 96bead697172ab7f2cf8346e04e65b837014d867 || echo "blis-registry: v0.3.0 moved off 96bead69" >&2
export BLIS_REGISTRY="$PWD/blis-registry"

# the commands run from this repo: router configs live here, scenarios/ is where you save each scenario
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/inference-sim/blis-config-search.git && cd blis-config-search && mkdir -p scenarios

# the replay corpus (not vendored anywhere; checked against its digest)
mkdir -p .corpus
curl -L -o .corpus/traces.jsonl https://huggingface.co/datasets/semianalysisai/cc-traces-weka-062126-256k/resolve/8fecd2fc56694469f758f0afbbb6335ad3043740/traces.jsonl
echo "e39cd2ff3eba21d4a3664be51da743ac3d2149a1933898cafc7bfeac8147eeef  .corpus/traces.jsonl" | shasum -a 256 -c

spec_yaml:
name: deepseek-v4-1-flash-h200-agentx-4node
scenario:
  model: deepseek-v4.1-flash
  hardware: h200
  workload: agentx-mvp
  gpus: 32
  slo:
    itl_p99: 20ms
  engine:
    cache_dtype: fp8_ds_mla
    max_model_len: 262144
  concurrency:
  - 32
  - 64
  - 96
  replay:
    corpus: .corpus/traces.jsonl
    corpus_cache: /tmp/agx-cache-h200
    grace_period: inf
sweeps:
- name: topology-ep
  narrative: Wide tp8 instances should win at the SLO, and EP should pay more as dp
    spreads 128 experts over more ranks.
  num-instances:
  - 1
  - 2
  - 4
  parallel:
    tp:
    - 8
    - 4
    dp:
    - 1
    - 2
    - 4
    enable_expert_parallel:
    - true
    - false
- name: batch-caps
  narrative: max_num_seqs 16 should bind on 4 instances but not 8, while a larger
    token budget lifts both until ITL breaks.
  num-instances:
  - 4
  - 8
  parallel:
    tp:
    - 8
    - 4
    dp:
    - 1
    enable_expert_parallel:
    - true
  engine:
    max_num_seqs:
    - 16
    - 256
    max_num_batched_tokens:
    - 4096
    - 8192
    - 16384
    - 32768
- name: prefill-chunking
  narrative: Capping long prefills should cut ITL p99 enough to push the SLO knee
    past 96 lanes, at a small cost in raw throughput.
  num-instances:
  - 4
  - 8
  parallel:
    tp:
    - 8
    - 4
    dp:
    - 1
    enable_expert_parallel:
    - true
  engine:
    long_prefill_token_threshold:
    - 1024
    - 2048
    - 4096
    max_num_batched_tokens:
    - 8192
    - 16384
- name: moe-collective
  narrative: DeepEP low-latency should win at EP width 4-8 and lose to high-throughput
    at width 32, where dispatch volume dominates.
  num-instances:
  - 1
  - 4
  - 8
  parallel:
    tp:
    - 8
    - 4
    dp:
    - 4
    - 1
    enable_expert_parallel:
    - true
  engine:
    all2all_backend:
    - deepep_high_throughput
    - deepep_low_latency
    - deepep_v2
    - pplx
- name: drafting
  narrative: dspark should raise tok/s/GPU at K 3-5 but lift ITL p99 toward the 20ms
    SLO, so the best K may differ between shapes.
  num-instances:
  - 4
  - 8
  parallel:
    tp:
    - 8
    - 4
    dp:
    - 1
    enable_expert_parallel:
    - true
  engine:
    speculative:
      method:
      - dspark
      num_spec_tokens:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
- name: routing-prefix-cache
  narrative: prefix-affinity with caching on should win, and the routing spread should
    widen from 4 to 8 instances.
  num-instances:
  - 4
  - 8
  parallel:
    tp:
    - 8
    - 4
    dp:
    - 1
    enable_expert_parallel:
    - true
  engine:
    enable_prefix_caching:
    - true
    - false
  router:
    endpoint_picker_config:
    - random.yaml
    - queue.yaml
    - load-aware.yaml
    - queue-kv.yaml
    - prefix-affinity.yaml
- name: kv-headroom
  narrative: gmu 0.95 should lift the KV-starved tp4 shapes noticeably and leave tp8
    flat.
  num-instances:
  - 4
  - 8
  parallel:
    tp:
    - 8
    - 4
    dp:
    - 1
    - 2
    enable_expert_parallel:
    - true
  engine:
    gpu_memory_utilization:
    - 0.95
- name: cudagraph
  narrative: FULL and FULL_AND_PIECEWISE should edge out the PIECEWISE default by
    a few percent, and NONE should collapse.
  num-instances:
  - 4
  parallel:
    tp:
    - 8
    dp:
    - 1
    enable_expert_parallel:
    - true
  engine:
    cudagraph_mode:
    - NONE
    - FULL
    - FULL_DECODE_ONLY
    - FULL_AND_PIECEWISE
